title: US House passes Iran war powers resolution in rare pushback against Trump
desc: Four Republicans allied with Democrats to pass bill to rein in Trump, though it is likely to face a presidential veto.

title: Canada will invest in US streamers like Netflix instead of hiking payments
desc: Canada's culture minister says the government has directed its television and communications regulator to back down from a recent decision to triple financial contributions required from U.S. streaming services such as Netflix for Canadian content.

title: NASA declares end to MAVEN Mars mission
desc: NASA has formally ended a Mars mission that has been out of contact for six months while the investigation into the spacecraft’s demise continues.

title: FIFA U-turns on World Cup water bottle policy, bans fans from bringing them into stadiums
desc: The code of conduct has been altered so fans will no longer be able to take in, or refill, water bottles.

title: Bushmeat banned: US Customs warns travellers against bringing wild animal meat into America
desc: US Customs and Border Protection warns travellers that bushmeat is prohibited from entering the United States, as CBP enforces laws protecting public health and animal life.

title: Israel and Lebanon agree to implement ceasefire if Hezbollah stops attacks
desc: The countries reject "any attempt, by any state or non-state actor, to hold Lebanon's future hostage", the US State Department said.

title: Kids and phones - smartphone VS dumbphone
desc: You don’t realise how quickly a ‘just in case’ phone turns into a daily battle… until you’re refereeing screen-time negotiations before breakfast.

title: Sri Lanka beats the West Indies by 41 runs in the 1st ODI as Nissanka scores 79
desc: Pathum Nissanka made a careful 79 and captain Kusal Mendis a fast-paced 72 to lay the foundation for Sri Lanka's 41-run win Wednesday over the West Indies in the first one-day cricket international. Nissanka and Mendis put on 136 for the second wicket and with contributions of 45 by Charith Asalanka and an unbeaten 44 by Janith Liyanage, Sri Lanka reached 303-7 after being asked to bat. Captain Shai Hope carried the fight to Sri Lanka with an innings of 56 from 66 balls and opener Justin Greaves made 45 from 38 balls, but the West Indies' were all out for 262 in the final over.

title: As TMC crisis deepens, for BJP the real payoff may be in Parliament
desc: BJP leaders feel once divided, TMC MPs may form a separate bloc in Parliament, bolster NDA tally and help it shore up numbers required to pass key Bills.

title: Japan sees shortage of plastic bags, trays and gloves, as Iran war-induced naphtha shortage worsens
desc: The Middle East is Japan’s main source of crude oil, from which naphtha is extracted and used to make items including printing ink and plastics
